title: Steady-state playbook digest: PM–Eng lead 1:1 prep (API, Console, Dedicated, Private)
text:
Steady-state playbook digest: PM–Eng lead 1:1 prep (API, Console, Dedicated, Private)

Quick context:
- Purpose: prime Lina (eng lead) for decisions and unblockers to land steady-state ops for hosted API + Dedicated pools and the first Private customer pilot. Keep this tight (20–30m).
- Background snapshot (last 2 weeks): hosted API p50=38ms, p95=210ms (spike at 5pm PT); Dedicated avg util=72% (GPU-hours trending up), Private pilot (ACME) onboarding delayed by certs + KMS policy review.

Agenda (20–30m):
1) Quick health check: current pain points (2–3 min)
2) Decision #1: Dedicated oversubscription policy — conservative vs controlled-burst (5 min)
3) Decision #2: Console rollout telemetry retention (3 min)
4) Action: Private pilot gating checklist and resource owners (8 min)
5) Wrap: 3 immediate next steps + owners + due dates (2–4 min)

Deep dives / talking bullets:
- Dedicated oversubscription:
  * Option A: 15% burst headroom (fast to enable, small risk of SLO blips)
  * Option B: priority-queueing + soft-fallback to hosted variants (more engineering, smoother UX)
  * My leaning: start with 15% controlled burst for next 2 weeks + realtime SLO alerting (low effort). Need Lina's take on ops-runbook for quick rollback.

- Console telemetry retention:
  * Current: 14d aggregated traces (costly when turned on for all teams). Ask: extend to 30d for prod models only or add sampling.
  * Proposal: 30d for routes tagged `critical`, 7d for others. Add toggle in console per-route.

- KV cache tuning & prefix caching:
  * Observed improvement for chat workloads when prefix cache hit rate > 0.6 (token cost -18%).
  * Action: ask infra to bump cache size on two hotspot pools; need signoff on memory vs throughput tradeoff.

- Private pilot (ACME) blockers:
  * KMS policy review (security) — blocker owner: Jaya (in progress).
  * Network egress and IP allowlist — waiting on ACME network team calendar.
  * Compliance docs (SOC2 excerpt) — Marcus to drop the current pull request for docs.

Decisions needed (explicit):
- Approve short-term Dedicated burst (15%)? (yes/no)
- Accept per-route telemetry retention defaults? (yes/no)
- Confirm owner for Private pilot runbook + go/no-go date? (who, date)

Open questions / notes-to-self: 
- If burst enabled, what circuit-breaker thresholds do SRE want? (ask Lina for recommended p95 threshold + error-rate delta)
- Do we want a one-week canary only for high-risk customers? (probably yes, list: ACME, BetaNet)
- Is there appetite to accelerate quantization trial for cold-start heavy workloads? (cost win but model quality risk)

Concrete asks for Lina in the meeting:
- TL;DR recommendation on Dedicated oversubscription (I bring telemetry and rollback playbook)
- Sign off to increase cache size on pools a and b next sprint (Jenkins job ID: infra/cache-bump-19)
- Assign SRE on-call to own the circuit-breaker thresholds if burst goes live (owner + contact)

Quick decision matrix (for verbal):
- Safety: Option B (priority queue + fallback) > A, but A faster.
- Time-to-value: A wins.
- Operational cost: A slightly higher risk for SRE; need rollback.

Post-meeting TODOs (draft):
- Lina — confirm Dedicated burst approach and give p95 rollback threshold (due: 2025-11-14)
- Jaya — finish KMS policy doc and ping ACME security (due: 2025-11-12)
- Marcus — merge SOC2 excerpt in onboarding docs and link in runbook (due: 2025-11-13)
- Omar (me) — draft short runbook for enabling burst + circuit-breaker playbook, share for review (due: 2025-11-13)
- Infra team (sprint) — implement cache size bump on pools a/b (Jenkins job queued) (due: 2025-11-20)

Fail/rollback criteria (notes):
- p95 increases > 30% vs baseline AND error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m -> urgent rollback.
- Any private pilot legal/compliance redline -> pause deploy until resolved.

Misc scratch:
- Quick link to metrics dashboard: GH:repo/metrics#dash-steady (put in slack after meeting)
- Save a short recording if Lina wants to forward to SRE on-call.
- Follow-up: schedule a 30-min alignment with SRE + infra for runbook handoff (prefer 2025-11-15).

Tone notes: keep the ask small, operational (not architectural), surface worst-case rollback plan first, then upside. Goal is to leave meeting with clear yes/no and assigned owners.

End.
